# Attribution

The JEPA backbone, transformer building blocks, SIGReg implementation, and parts of the training/evaluation infrastructure derive from INTACT and LeWM. Their MIT notices are preserved alongside this file. FlexiWorld adds the variable-chunk action pathway, full-method training objective, and autoregressive residual planner.

Runtime dependencies retain their own licenses. The code license does not grant rights to redistribute third-party datasets or checkpoints. The overview figure in `assets/` is paper material, not part of the MIT-licensed software.
